statement: Between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-27, at least one merchant vessel is struck, attacked, boarded, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf, as logged by UKMTO.
resolution: TRUE if the UKMTO website or official X account publishes an incident or warning dated 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-27 reporting a merchant vessel struck, attacked, boarded, or seized in those waters; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is struck, attacked, boarded, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-27.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
